newsitem.title: TAIWAN: First Bank to set up Vietnam office.
newsitem.headline: First Bank to set up Vietnam office.

text.p: Taiwan's state-run First Commercial Bank will set up a representative office in Vietnam's Ho Chi Minh City on September 10, the bank said on Monday.

"Since there are increasing Taiwanese businessmen investing in Vietnam, we plan to set up a representative in Ho Chi Minh City to provide them financial information and services," the bank said in a statement.
The bank would upgrade the representative, its 10th overseas office, to a branch as soon as possible, it said.
First Commercial Bank is one of Taiwan's "Big Three" state-run banks and the first state bank to set up an office in Vietnam.
